definitions.explanation: replacing someone in an official position, often a high-ranking person, typically due to poor performance or scandal

examples.japanese: ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{更迭|こうてつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{更迭|こうてつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The replacement of the manager was announced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不祥事|ふしょうじ}→不祥事：14981_fushouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧、⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{更迭|こうてつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The president was removed from his position, taking responsibility for the scandal.

notes:
{更迭|こうてつ} means to replace or remove someone from an official position, often used in political and business contexts.

WRITING:
- {更|こう} (change, renew)
- {迭|てつ} (alternate, replace)

USAGE:
- {更迭|こうてつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to replace/remove - suru verb)
- {更迭|こうてつ}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be replaced/removed)
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{更迭|こうてつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to remove ~ from position)
- ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{更迭|こうてつ} (cabinet reshuffle)
- ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{更迭|こうてつ} (manager replacement in sports)
- ⟦{幹部|かんぶ}→幹部：06875_kanbu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{更迭|こうてつ} (executive reshuffle)
- Often implies removal due to failure, scandal, or pressure
- More formal than ⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧ (replacement/rotation)
- Common in news reporting

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{解任|かいにん}→解任：17173_kainin⟧ (dismissal)
- ⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧ (resignation)
- ⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧ (replacement - neutral term)
